indicators.label: Resident Population Aged 15 Years and Over
indicators.description: Published census table total for the planning area.
indicators.method: Use the table's Total column without adjustment.
indicators.spatial_coverage: Singapore planning areas on each census wave's matching URA Master Plan vintage.
indicators.quality_notes: The published whole-person category counts have small additivity residuals.

indicators.label: Religious affiliation %
indicators.description: Share declaring a listed religion. Religion refers to the religious faith or spiritual belief declared by the person. Regular attendance at religious ceremonies and regular practice are not required for the declaration.
indicators.method: 100 times (Total minus No Religion) divided by Total. The difference equals the table's published With Religion construct and avoids imputing unavailable minor-category cells.
indicators.spatial_coverage: Singapore planning areas on each census wave's matching URA Master Plan vintage.
indicators.quality_notes: Taoism includes Chinese Traditional Beliefs. Published category counts are preserved.

indicators.label: No religion %
indicators.description: Share in the table's own No Religion category.
indicators.method: 100 times No Religion divided by Total.
indicators.spatial_coverage: Singapore planning areas on each census wave's matching URA Master Plan vintage.
indicators.quality_notes: Religion refers to the religious faith or spiritual belief declared by the person. Regular attendance at religious ceremonies and regular practice are not required for the declaration.
